title: SensorReading
description: Standard schema for physiological and biometric readings provided by device_integration module.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this sample packet was emitted.

heart_rate_bpm.description: Current heart rate in beats per minute. MUST be null if reading is unavailable; NEVER represent missing data as 0.

data_status.description: Integrity flag. Explicitly distinguishes genuine live BLE, historical health connect, simulated demo, stale, and unavailable.

last_reading_timestamp.description: Timestamp of the last verified reading from the sensor, or null if never connected.

device_battery_percent.description: Optional battery percentage reported by the peripheral.

connection_status.description: True if sensor device is currently connected and active.

data_freshness_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds since reading was captured.

error_state.description: Descriptive hardware or connection error details, if any.
